title: Maya Cities Under the Jungle: What Lidar Found
hook: What if a jungle has been hiding millions of people?
thumbnail_picture: Dramatic aerial view of a dense Guatemalan jungle canopy, with glowing golden laser-scan lines peeling the trees away to reveal a huge stone Maya pyramid and rows of buried houses beneath, misty dawn light, epic scale
description:
Maya cities under the jungle: what did lidar find in Guatemala's Petén? Fly over the 2018 laser survey that revealed more than 60,000 hidden Maya structures.
Discover how a dense, connected lowland network sharpened the old idea of scattered cities, and why it changes the story of the Maya.

Sources: Canuto et al., "Ancient lowland Maya complexity as revealed by airborne laser scanning of northern Guatemala," Science (2018); PACUNAM Lidar Initiative, Fundación PACUNAM; Michael D. Coe, The Maya; Smithsonian Magazine and National Geographic reporting on the 2018 survey.

Animation and narration are AI-assisted; script reviewed by a human.

how many maya lived in guatemala

scenes.narration: You're standing in a Guatemalan rainforest, and the green is so thick you can't see ten steps ahead.
scenes.caption: PETÉN, GUATEMALA
scenes.picture: First-person view of a dense Guatemalan rainforest trail, thick green vegetation closing in, shafts of humid morning light, a pair of muddy hiking boots at the bottom of frame

scenes.narration: Roots snag your boots. Somewhere above, howler monkeys roar.
scenes.caption: THE JUNGLE
scenes.picture: Close-up of tangled tree roots and wet leaves on a jungle floor, a muddy boot caught among them, a howler monkey silhouetted high in the canopy

scenes.narration: All you see is leaves. Hold that thought.
scenes.caption: JUST LEAVES
scenes.picture: Close-up of huge wet green jungle leaves with droplets of water, soft light, nothing else visible

scenes.narration: Because beneath this green, something enormous has been waiting for more than a thousand years.
scenes.caption: BURIED
scenes.picture: Cutaway view of jungle soil showing the dark outlines of ancient stone steps and walls buried under roots and earth, moody light

scenes.narration: Not a few scattered ruins. A whole civilization, packed in far tighter than many people had imagined.
scenes.caption: THE MAYA
scenes.picture: Wide view of a Maya stone pyramid temple rising above a sea of jungle canopy at dawn, mist in the valleys

scenes.narration: To understand the shock, you first need to know what many scholars used to believe.
scenes.caption: THE OLD IDEA
scenes.picture: A weathered archaeologist in a khaki shirt pausing on a jungle trail, looking up at a vine-covered stone temple wall, thoughtful expression

scenes.narration: It's the 1840s, and explorers like John Lloyd Stephens and Frederick Catherwood are hacking through the forest with machetes, documenting Maya ruins across the region.
scenes.caption: 1840s: EXPLORERS
scenes.picture: Two 19th-century explorers in wide hats and linen coats cutting through dense jungle with machetes, a mule loaded with gear behind them

scenes.narration: Suddenly a carved stone face stares out of the vines.
scenes.caption: A STONE FACE
scenes.picture: A carved Maya stone face half-hidden by hanging vines and moss in the jungle, dramatic shaft of light

scenes.narration: In 1848, a Guatemalan expedition reaches Tikal. Over the next century, archaeologists uncover great cities, towers climbing above the trees.
scenes.caption: 1848: TIKAL REACHED
scenes.picture: Tikal-style tall limestone temple pyramids with steep stairs rising above the jungle canopy, golden afternoon light, tourists absent

scenes.narration: They're magnificent. But they look like islands of stone in an ocean of forest.
scenes.caption: ISLANDS OF STONE
scenes.picture: A single Maya temple pyramid poking out of an endless green jungle ocean, far from any other building, wide empty landscape

scenes.narration: So for much of the 20th century, many scholars pictured a handful of rival city-states, scattered far apart.
scenes.caption: SCATTERED CITIES
scenes.picture: Aerial view of three far-apart Maya stone cities, each a small cluster of temples, separated by vast unbroken forest, soft haze

scenes.narration: Between them? Mostly forest, and, in that picture, a few farmers burning small patches to grow corn.
scenes.caption: FEW FARMERS
scenes.picture: A lone Maya farmer in a simple cotton tunic planting maize in a small burned clearing in the forest, smoke curling up

scenes.narration: The soil is thin. The rains are fickle. Surely, many experts thought, this land couldn't feed a crowd.
scenes.caption: THIN SOIL
scenes.picture: Close-up of cracked, thin pale soil with a few dry corn stalks wilting in the sun, jungle edge behind

scenes.narration: For decades, mapping the truth meant crawling through the undergrowth, one patch at a time.
scenes.caption: SLOW WORK
scenes.picture: Sweaty field archaeologists with measuring tape and notebooks crawling through thick undergrowth beneath giant trees, insects in the air

scenes.narration: Snakes. Heat. Mosquitoes. And a mound that might just be a hill.
scenes.caption: JUST A HILL?
scenes.picture: A grassy overgrown mound in the jungle that could be a hill or a buried building, a coiled snake on a nearby root, archaeologist squinting at it

scenes.narration: By the 1980s, some had argued for far denser settlement, but nobody could prove it across the whole forest. So what was really out there, under the leaves?
scenes.caption: THE BIG QUESTION
scenes.picture: Dusk view over an endless jungle canopy with low mist, a lone figure on a temple summit gazing out across it

scenes.narration: Now fast-forward to 2016. You climb into a small plane in northern Guatemala.
scenes.caption: THE SURVEY
scenes.picture: A small propeller survey plane on a grassy airstrip at dawn, a scientist climbing aboard with a rugged case, jungle all around

scenes.narration: Strapped underneath is a machine that fires laser light at the ground.
scenes.caption: LIDAR
scenes.picture: Close-up of a boxy scanning instrument bolted under the belly of a small aircraft, a thin green laser beam firing downward

scenes.narration: They call it lidar. Light detection and ranging.
scenes.caption: LIGHT + RANGING
scenes.picture: Side view of an aircraft sending a fan of thin green laser lines down onto a forested hillside in clear sky

scenes.narration: The plane lifts off, and the jungle slides beneath you like a green carpet.
scenes.caption: TAKEOFF
scenes.picture: View from a plane window of an endless green jungle canopy stretching to the horizon at sunrise, wing edge in frame

scenes.narration: The laser sends out hundreds of thousands of pulses a second toward the trees.
scenes.caption: PULSES OF LIGHT
scenes.picture: Thousands of tiny glowing green laser dots raining down onto a jungle canopy from above, dramatic night-like glow

scenes.narration: Most bounce off the leaves. But a few slip through the gaps and hit the ground.
scenes.caption: THROUGH THE GAPS
scenes.picture: Cutaway of jungle layers showing green laser lines hitting leaves while a few thin beams pass between branches to touch the forest floor

scenes.narration: Then software does something that feels like magic. It filters out the canopy returns, leaving a model of the bare ground.
scenes.caption: TREES FILTERED OUT
scenes.picture: A glowing digital-looking landscape where jungle trees dissolve into particles of light, revealing bare terrain with faint stone shapes beneath

scenes.narration: Months later, analysts open the first processed images. Picture the team crowded around a screen in a lab.
scenes.caption: MONTHS LATER
scenes.picture: Several analysts gathered around a large lab monitor showing a grayscale lidar relief map of terrain, soft glow on their faces, modern research lab

scenes.narration: Imagine the first image loading, slowly. You'd hold your breath.
scenes.caption: IMAGINE THE MOMENT
scenes.picture: Extreme close-up of a researcher's wide eyes reflecting a computer screen glow, tense silence, soft light

scenes.narration: The forest floor appears, and it isn't empty. Not even close.
scenes.caption: NOT EMPTY
scenes.picture: A grayscale-relief terrain scan look: bare ground of the Petén with crisp raised outlines of rectangles and platforms densely scattered, seen from above

scenes.narration: Rows of tiny rectangles. Thousands of them, packed side by side.
scenes.caption: HOUSE FOUNDATIONS
scenes.picture: Aerial painting of dense rows of low rectangular stone house platforms in cleared ground, laid out like a neighborhood, soft light

scenes.narration: Those are house foundations. Homes where ordinary families once cooked, slept and argued.
scenes.caption: ORDINARY HOMES
scenes.picture: Interior of a Maya thatched-roof house with a family around a clay hearth, mother shaping maize dough, children playing, warm firelight

scenes.narration: The survey covered about 2,100 square kilometers of the Maya Biosphere Reserve.
scenes.caption: 2,100 KM²
scenes.picture: Sweeping aerial view of a vast protected rainforest reserve in northern Guatemala stretching to distant hills, low sun, rivers of mist

scenes.narration: Scientists announced the result in early 2018. More than 60,000 hidden structures.
scenes.caption: 60,000+ STRUCTURES
scenes.picture: Scientists at a press briefing looking at a giant projected glowing lidar relief map of a landscape, bright room

scenes.narration: Houses. Palaces. Temples. Ball courts. Sixty thousand, from a single flight program.
scenes.caption: SIXTY THOUSAND
scenes.picture: Montage-like wide painting of a Maya city landscape with houses in front, a palace complex mid-ground and temple pyramids behind, all uncovered from forest

scenes.narration: Now picture what these places looked like when they were alive.
scenes.caption: BACK IN TIME
scenes.picture: Misty ruins dissolving into a bustling living Maya city in bright daylight, white limestone plazas and red painted temples

scenes.narration: It's around the year 750. You walk a stone road into a roaring city.
scenes.caption: AROUND 750 CE
scenes.picture: First-person view walking along a wide white-plastered causeway toward a bustling Maya city with tall temples, people ahead, midday sun

scenes.narration: Traders shout. Porters stagger under baskets of cacao, salt and obsidian.
scenes.caption: THE MARKET
scenes.picture: Busy Maya marketplace with porters carrying baskets of cacao pods, salt blocks and black obsidian blades, colorful cotton cloth awnings

scenes.narration: Overhead, a temple climbs into the sky, painted bright red.
scenes.caption: RED TEMPLE
scenes.picture: Looking up at a tall Maya temple pyramid painted vivid red with steep steps, blue sky, a priest in feathered headdress at the top

scenes.narration: And lidar shows roads, raised causeways, linking one city after another.
scenes.caption: CAUSEWAYS
scenes.picture: Aerial view of long straight raised white stone causeways running through jungle, joining distant cities on the horizon

scenes.narration: Some are miles long. Some were built centuries before the famous cities peaked.
scenes.caption: ANCIENT HIGHWAYS
scenes.picture: A long raised Maya causeway stretching straight to the horizon at sunset, workers carrying stones along its edge

scenes.narration: So the "islands" weren't islands at all. They were neighbors.
scenes.caption: NEIGHBORS
scenes.picture: Wide aerial view of several Maya cities close together linked by causeways and farmland between them, no empty gaps

scenes.narration: Between the cities, the scans reveal walls, terraces and fields climbing every hillside.
scenes.caption: TERRACES
scenes.picture: Hillsides carved into stone-walled terraces with green crops, tiny farmers tending them in the sun, a distant city on a ridge

scenes.narration: This was intensive farming on a huge scale. Not a few corn patches, but a landscape reshaped.
scenes.caption: INTENSIVE FARMING
scenes.picture: Wide view of large fields of maize and beans stretching between canals and terraces, many farmers working together in the morning

scenes.narration: Canals carried water. Reservoirs held it for the long dry months.
scenes.caption: WATER ENGINEERING
scenes.picture: A stone-lined reservoir full of blue water beside a Maya city, a canal feeding it, people collecting water in clay jars

scenes.narration: Imagine hauling that much earth by hand, without a single wheel or draft animal.
scenes.caption: NO WHEELS
scenes.picture: Crowd of Maya workers carrying baskets of earth on their backs up a growing embankment, no wheels, strain on their faces, dust in the air

scenes.narration: Then, the scans reveal something darker: fortifications. Walls, moats, defensive ditches around cities.
scenes.caption: FORTIFICATIONS
scenes.picture: A thick stone defensive wall with a deep ditch outside it around a Maya city, watchtower above, stormy grey sky

scenes.narration: These people were not peaceful neighbors. Rival kings fought, and they dug in.
scenes.caption: WAR
scenes.picture: Maya warriors with spears, jaguar-skin capes and shields clashing near a walled city gate, dust and tension, painted in dramatic light

scenes.narration: And the scale of it all points to a question of numbers. How many people lived here?
scenes.caption: HOW MANY?
scenes.picture: A packed Maya plaza seen from a temple stair, a huge crowd of people in cotton clothing filling it to the edges, midday sun

scenes.narration: Earlier estimates varied, often from a few million to several million.
scenes.caption: EARLIER ESTIMATES
scenes.picture: A modest Maya village of thatched houses and a few dozen people in a clearing, soft grey light

scenes.narration: The lidar team argues for more. They estimate that seven to eleven million people may have lived across the central Maya lowlands at the peak.
scenes.caption: 7–11 MILLION (LOWLANDS, EST.)
scenes.picture: Sprawling Maya lowland landscape dense with homes, farms, plazas and temples as far as the eye can see, thousands of people, golden hour

scenes.narration: Historians stress that's an extrapolation, not a headcount. But even the low end shocks.
scenes.caption: AN ESTIMATE
scenes.picture: Researchers debating at a table covered with printed scan images and a laptop, one pointing, others skeptically leaning in, afternoon light

scenes.narration: That's on the scale of a modern country's population, hidden under trees.
scenes.caption: A HIDDEN NATION
scenes.picture: Misty aerial view of a modern jungle where faint glowing ghost outlines of a huge dense ancient city appear above the trees

scenes.narration: So the old picture flips. Not scattered cities, but a dense, connected network.
scenes.caption: THE NEW PICTURE
scenes.picture: Aerial view of many Maya cities linked by glowing causeways in a web across the lowlands, suburbs and farmland between them

scenes.narration: Cities that sprawled into suburbs. Suburbs that touched the next city's farms.
scenes.caption: MAYA SUBURBS
scenes.picture: Edge of a Maya city where dense house platforms and gardens fade into neighboring fields and another city's temples in the distance

scenes.narration: Even at the famous Tikal, lidar showed the earthworks and neighborhoods reaching further than the old maps.
scenes.caption: TIKAL, REMAPPED
scenes.picture: Tikal-style temples in the center with rows of homes, earthworks and fields spreading far outward into the forest, aerial view at sunrise

scenes.narration: So why did the southern cities go quiet? Many scholars point to drought, war, and strain on the land, though the causes are still debated.
scenes.caption: THE COLLAPSE
scenes.picture: A dry cracked reservoir bed with a deserted Maya city behind it, wilted crops, brown sky, empty paths

scenes.narration: A packed land has little slack when the rains fail for years.
scenes.caption: WHEN RAIN FAILED
scenes.picture: A hungry Maya mother and child sitting by an empty grain basket in a dusty courtyard, a harsh bright sun, worried faces

scenes.narration: Most southern lowland cities emptied by about 900 CE. And the forest crept in.
scenes.caption: THE FOREST RETURNS
scenes.picture: A once-busy Maya plaza now empty, green shoots pushing through the stones, a lone vine climbing a temple wall, soft dusk

scenes.narration: Roots swallowed stairs. Soil piled over walls. Over the following centuries, the cities disappeared under green.
scenes.caption: SWALLOWED
scenes.picture: A huge tree with roots wrapped around old stone temple steps, moss everywhere, green dim light

scenes.narration: But the Maya themselves never vanished. Millions of their descendants live in the region today.
scenes.caption: STILL HERE
scenes.picture: A smiling modern Maya family in colorful woven clothing in a Guatemalan village, a market behind them, warm daylight

scenes.narration: Back in the lab, the team keeps scrolling. Every new square kilometer holds surprises.
scenes.caption: STILL SCROLLING
scenes.picture: Archaeologists excitedly pointing at a large monitor showing a lidar relief map in a dim modern lab

scenes.narration: Some of those surprises are now being checked on foot, with machetes, the old-fashioned way.
scenes.caption: GROUND-TRUTHING
scenes.picture: A small team following a GPS device through thick jungle, one cutting vines with a machete, heading toward a dark mound

scenes.narration: And the survey only touched a sliver of the lowlands. Much more may be waiting.
scenes.caption: MORE TO FIND
scenes.picture: Pilot's view over a huge unbroken rainforest to the horizon, with faint scanned strips glowing in just one small part, rest unexplored

scenes.narration: So next time you see a calm green jungle, remember the laser.
scenes.caption: REMEMBER THE LASER
scenes.picture: A calm sunlit rainforest canopy with a single thin green laser line passing down through it, peaceful

scenes.narration: Under every leaf, there may be a doorway, a street, a whole forgotten neighborhood.
scenes.caption: A FORGOTTEN STREET
scenes.picture: A narrow ancient stone-paved street with house foundations on both sides emerging from jungle moss, shaft of morning light

scenes.narration: The jungle hid its true scale for over a thousand years. A beam of light finally asked the right question.
scenes.caption: THE SECRET, OUT
scenes.picture: Sunrise over a vast jungle canopy where a great Maya temple stands lit golden above the trees, birds flying, peaceful and majestic

narrator: Immersive cinematic narrator, vivid and present-tense, tense and fast in the action, hushed in awe.
